## skenv repo

Set up and check the repository templates of a skills repository

```
skenv repo [flags]
```

### Examples

```console
$ skenv repo init --visibility private
$ skenv repo init --visibility public --ci gitlab
$ skenv repo check
$ skenv repo apply
$ skenv repo upgrade
```

### Options

```
      --dir string   repository (any directory inside it) (default ".")
  -h, --help         help for repo
```

* [skenv](skenv.md)	 - Install agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, pi) from a manifest in git
